scope: 独立内容审校学习者 B-denial 实作及其 learner/QA 边界、tenant/source scope、first failure、holdout 与限制措辞

learner_qa_boundary.finding: learner 包 qa_status=pending/self_signed=false；独立 QA 不替代学习者五项 D0 证据

tenant_source_scope.finding: A baseline carries tenant/source tuple; B private and wrong-tenant deny before generation; fixture is not production ACL

first_failure.finding: B-private recorded as first failure with downstream generation false; preserve original

holdout.finding: non-isomorphic document_id/source_version/text holdout dynamically denied; mixed request enters recovery_required/hold_for_human_review

limitation_wording.finding: local deterministic/no real model or permission system/no level grant stated; production security and capability remain unverified

required_followups: Bind B-denial outputs item-by-item to the same learner five D0 answers and a complete EvidenceCard; re-run independent QA/REV.
Keep production ACL, provider source API, concurrency, crash recovery/RPO-RTO, leakage, human receipt and unknown-task transfer unverified.
Version state contract distinguishing SOURCE_SCOPE_DENIED from recovery_required/hold_for_human_review.
non_claims: B-denial QA is not learner pass or certification.
Local dictionary/JSON fixture is not a real authorization system or production security proof.
No L1/L2, production permission, model quality, or career capability is granted.
